prompt: Were Miranda warnings given before the questioning?

options.label: Warnings were given but were incomplete, garbled, or misleading

prompt: When your client waived their Miranda rights, did any of these circumstances apply? Select all that apply; leave blank if none.

options.label: Your client doesn't speak or read English well, and the warnings were given in English
Your client has a mental illness, intellectual disability, or similar condition
Your client was injured, in pain, or exhausted
Police promised your client something (leniency, release, help with charges)
Police lied to or misled your client about the rights or the situation
Police kept pushing after your client hesitated or declined
Your client never expressly waived — they just answered questions after the warnings
